questions.question: You are building a Python app that sends a photo and a question to a deployed GPT-4.1 model by using the Responses API. Which content part type should contain the photo?

options.why: input_text carries the written question, not the image.
Correct. The input_image part carries the image as a data URL or an https URL.
input_audio carries audio data for audio-capable models.
output_text is how the model's reply is read, not an input.

questions.explanation: In the Responses API, a user message can contain an input_text part for the question and an input_image part for the image.

questions.question: Which TWO formats can you use to supply an image in the image_url value of an input_image part?

options.text: A base64 data URL, such as data:image/jpeg;base64,...
options.why: Correct. A data URL embeds the image bytes directly in the request.
Correct. The service can fetch an image from an https URL.

options.text: A local file path, such as C:\photos\leaf.jpg
options.why: The service cannot read files on your computer. Encode the file as a data URL instead.

options.text: The name of a model deployment
options.why: The deployment name belongs in the model parameter.

questions.explanation: An image can be sent as a base64 data URL or as an https URL that the service can reach.

questions.question: Your vision app creates an AIProjectClient. Which authentication method does the client support?

options.text: An API key passed in an AzureKeyCredential
options.why: AIProjectClient does not support key-based authentication.

options.text: Microsoft Entra ID, for example by using DefaultAzureCredential
options.why: Correct. AIProjectClient supports Microsoft Entra ID authentication only.
SAS tokens are used for Azure Storage, not for the Foundry project client.
Foundry projects require authenticated access.

questions.explanation: The Foundry SDK project client authenticates with Microsoft Entra ID. DefaultAzureCredential uses az login credentials during local development.

questions.scenario: An online store needs a caption and a list of tags for each of two million catalogue photos. The output format must be identical for every photo, and no user questions are involved.
questions.question: Which service is the most appropriate?

options.text: Azure Vision in Foundry Tools image analysis
options.why: Correct. Image analysis returns captions and tags in a consistent structured format without a prompt.
gpt-image-1 creates and edits images. It does not caption them.
Speech services process audio, not images.
Language services analyze text, not images.

questions.explanation: When the required output is a fixed set of visual features such as captions and tags, Azure Vision image analysis provides predictable structured results.

questions.question: After calling responses.create with an image and a question, which property contains the model's text answer?

options.why: Correct. output_text returns the combined text output of the response.
b64_json holds image data returned by images.generate.
fields belongs to Content Understanding analysis results.
The Responses API does not return a single confidence property.

questions.explanation: The Responses API exposes the model's text reply through output_text.
